reason: Group-A positive excess is FP/background enriched and intersects OGL RemoveFP, but it does not distinguish RemoveFP from RemoveTP (pixel AUROC ~0.49), while AUD-better samples have substantially more GT excess and more RemoveTP overlap. Direct suppression is unsafe.
alignment: Formal evaluation grid: each native map independently bicubic-resized to 224x224 then per-map min-max normalized. IQR=minmax(0.6*AUD+0.4*IMG_QUERY); OGL=minmax(0.6*AUD+0.4*OBJ_PRIOR). PositiveExcess=max(AUD-IMG_QUERY,0). Threshold .6 only for existing AUD-to-OGL transition masks; excess itself stays continuous.
